runtime.name: Blender
runtime.scope: Generator and rendering with bundled Python and glTF exporter 4.3.47

runtime.name: three
runtime.scope: Optional offline GLTFLoader parse only, not required by generator

runtime.name: gltf-validator
runtime.scope: Optional format validation only, not required by generator

dependency_closure: Generator reads only adjacent params.json and imports vendored deps/asset_common.py and its transitive qa_glb.py. Blender and Python standard library are the only required runtime dependencies. No other asset, external reference image or absolute workspace path is read.
